info.name: RozFM Admin Panel API Collection
info.description: Complete standalone Postman collection for RozFM Admin Panel APIs including Dashboard, User Management, Content Management (Stories/Episodes), Categories, Banners, Monetization, Content Moderation, Push Notifications, and System Settings.

request.description: Authenticate an administrator user using email and password to receive a JWT access token.
Logout the currently authenticated administrator user.
Fetch overall metrics (total users, active stories, episodes, play counts, revenue, recent registrations, and top stories).
Fetch story performance metrics (Total Plays, Avg Completion Rate, Avg Rating, New Titles in last 30d, Plays Over Time chart data, and Plays By Category breakdown).
Fetch paginated users with optional filters by search term, role (Listener/Creator/Admin), or block status.
Fetch complete profile of a single user along with overview metrics, wallet transactions, listening history, premium status, devices, and reports.
Fetch User Overview tab metrics (Coin balance, total listening hours, completed stories, lifetime spend, extended profile info).
Fetch User Wallet & Coins tab transactions list.
Fetch User Listening History tab data (stories played, genre, episodes played, last played timestamp).
Fetch User Premium Status tab data (active membership plan, renewal date, remaining billing days).
Fetch User Devices & Logins tab data (device name, OS version, login location, last login time).
Fetch User Moderation Reports tab data.
Create a new user account from the Admin Panel with role, plan, and initial status.
Update user details, subscription plan, locale, role, password (optional), or suspend/ban status.
Permanently delete a user account by ID.
Credit (+) or Debit (-) coin balance in a user's wallet with a custom description/reason.

query.description: Filter by status: scheduled, draft, published, ongoing, completed
Alternative query parameter flag for scheduled stories

request.description: Fetch paginated list of scheduled stories with release dates.

query.description: Alternative query parameter flag for draft stories

request.description: Fetch paginated list of unpublished draft stories.
Fetch detailed information for a single story by ID for admin viewing/editing.

formdata.value: Short description shown on the story page

formdata.description: Publish date formatted as YYYY-MM-DD or null

request.description: Create a new story with multipart form-data (title, category, language, description/synopsis, cover_image, banner_image, creator, status, is_premium).

formdata.value: Updated description for the story page

formdata.description: Publish date formatted as YYYY-MM-DD or null

request.description: Update an existing story details and images.
Get paginated list of all episodes with optional filters (story_id, search, is_premium, filter/status).
Get details for a single episode by ID including duration, parent story info, audio path and pricing.
Create a new episode for a story with title, story_id, audio_file, duration, is_premium, and published_at date/time.
Update an existing episode's metadata, audio file, duration, premium access, or publication date.
Delete an episode by ID and update parent story episodes_count.

query.description: Filter by Home, Explore, or Player
Search creators by name, username, email, or phone
Filter by status: all, active, pending, suspended

request.description: Fetch paginated list of creators including creator name, stories count, followers count, rev share %, earnings, status, and verification badge.
Fetch master profile of a creator including published stories list, total views, followers count, lifetime earnings, rev share %, and status.
Invite or create a new creator account with custom rev share percentage, verification badge, and initial status.
Update creator profile info, bio, verification checkmark, custom rev share %, or status.
Quick status update endpoint (active, pending, suspended).
Permanently delete a creator account by ID.

query.description: Search by writer name, email, phone, bank account, or upi_id
Filter by status: all, pending, paid, approved, rejected

request.description: Fetch paginated list of writer withdrawal requests including writer info, requested amount, bank/UPI details, status, transaction ref, and summary metrics.
Fetch details of a single withdrawal request along with writer profile, saved bank/UPI details, and writer's financial summary.
Process withdrawal request by marking status as 'paid', 'approved', or 'rejected', specifying paid payment method (bank_transfer, upi, gpay, etc.), transaction reference (UTR), and notes.
Delete a withdrawal request record.
